headline: Cottagers Host United, Ties Held Hostage
deck: Fulham v Man Utd puts four open head-to-heads on the line, Cunha and B.Fernandes leading the men split across it.
body:
Four ties come to this fixture unresolved and every one has a man on each side of it. test2 leads test1 16-11, and the split is clean: Dalot for test1, Cunha for test2. The wider gulf is test4's, six against 123's twenty-six, with Mbeumo carrying the deficit and B.Fernandes standing for the side already clear.

Elsewhere the margins are tighter. test3, with Maguire and Gonzalo, trails test31121 and Berge by two. test211 hold King and Castagne against Leno for test3331, six adrift of eighteen. Bobb is in it too, no duel to his name, watching for test31 as the league's top scorers chase testf's lead. Ninety minutes, four ledgers, and nobody knows yet which way any of them tips.
